summary: Only a Forest Lookouts list entry names a Horseshoe tower in Dixie County; no build, staffing, status or site record was found, so no story was written.

evidence.supports: list entry names Horseshoe, Dixie County

notes_for_editor: No story written. The only source is the Forest Lookouts list page, which gives the name and county of a Horseshoe tower and nothing else. Two searches, one for a Dixie County tower history, found nothing about it. The Florida Forest Fire Lookout Association 2015 report (firelookout.org cr-fl-2015.pdf) has no entry for it, and no NHLR or FFLOS record exists for a Florida Horseshoe tower. The 2026 Dixie County wildfire news is about a fire, not this tower. A story would fall well short of the 120-word floor without inventing content. It needs a tower-specific source (Florida Forest Service records, a register nomination, or a newspaper item) before a story is written. The record's coordinates (29.52723, -83.2409) are unchecked against any source.
